trans-unit.source: Mandant: Place the number of the mandant of the city (only BW).
Token: Enter the Bearer Authorization Token. You can generate one here: https://sgw.service-bw.de/rest-v2/documentation/
URI of Service BW API: To which URI the API requests should be send?. Normally: https://sgw.service-bw.de:443/

Allowed languages: Define multiple allowed languages. Format: [2 letters language ISO code of Service BW]=[2 letters language ISO code of TYPO3 locale]. Assign multiple languages with ";". Example: de=de;en=en. First value will be used as default language
Description from Service BW API - Die IDs der Gebiete, in deren Kontext man diese Operation ausführen möchte.:Optional parameter for API requests. Leave empty to not use this filter option.

Description from Service BW API - Die amtlichen Gemeindeschlüssel, in deren Kontext man diese Operation ausführen möchte.:Optional parameter for API requests. Leave empty to not use this filter option.
Maximum tree depth: How many levels of organizational units should be loaded and displayed in the tree view?
